facts.fact: Moonsamy and Singh state that the SAP Health Information System has been rolled out to most of the public hospitals in Gauteng province and aims to centralise patient health and other records within the province, also handling hospital bed management; no count of hospitals is given and the rollout is undated, so the document's published date is used.

systems.tiers: most public hospitals in Gauteng province
Gauteng public hospitals and emergency medical services (proposed)

note: The paper is a design proposal for a bed-occupancy and ambulance-divert console in Gauteng; its only statement about a system in use is the SAP HIS rollout to most Gauteng public hospitals. It also states ambulance divert information is not digitised and hospitals cannot see each other's bed occupancy.
